title: Occupational Safety and Health Act of 1970 — Statute profile
subject: Occupational Safety and Health Act of 1970
summary: Occupational Safety and Health Act of 1970 is a statute of United States enacted in 1970, in the area of workplace safety. Created OSHA to set and enforce workplace safety standards. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 91-596.
key_points: Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
